identityTest.stableIdentity: A governed planning iteration remains identifiable across scope changes, capacity updates, work-item state changes and closure.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Planning-close seals an immutable commitment baseline; later membership or capacity changes create append-only scope-change records rather than rewriting that baseline.

owns: iteration closure, cancellation and rollover evidence

references.purpose: Employment or team context used in capacity declarations

invariants: Iteration identity is independent of backlog, project, board and any member WorkItem.
Every iteration states offset-qualified timebox bounds and an accountable owner.
Planning close seals one immutable commitment baseline with work items and capacity snapshot.
Post-close membership or capacity changes are append-only scope-change records.
WorkItem state changes never rewrite iteration commitment history.
Rollover creates explicit successor membership and never erases incomplete prior commitment.
Cancellation records reason and disposition without claiming delivered result.
Capacity is a declared planning input and never inferred from velocity alone.
Actual effort and elapsed time remain externally mastered and never overwrite estimates or capacity.
Iteration closure never proves WorkItem acceptance or Requirement satisfaction.
One WorkItem may appear in successor iterations only through explicit rollover or new commitment records.
Closed and retired iteration identifiers remain resolvable and are never recycled.
holds: Registry namespace and identifier allocation are pending and no identifier may be guessed.
Capacity, calendar and tracker-adapter crosswalks require frozen audit.
Package conversion and live verification are pending.
